item: Clearing expiration leaves a dangling timer pointer
note: Independent public-API probe panicked natively. Miri with Tree Borrows confirmed use-after-free in unlink_timer after the None branch drops a node without clearing its entry pointer.

item: Unit error type collides with infallible initialization
note: Reproduced in both implementations: try_get_with returning Err(()) makes a concurrent same-key get_with panic at unreachable!(). Both use the unit TypeId.

item: Concurrent invalidation timestamps can move backward
note: Both implementations capture time before an unconditional atomic store. A delayed older invalidator can overwrite a newer cutoff and expose entries inserted between those timestamps. The 100,000-iteration stress probe did not reproduce it.

item: Asynchronous computations unlock before applying their operation
note: Paused the first and_upsert_with inside its weigher; a second same-key computation completed before release. Two increments from zero produced one, confirming lost updates despite documented serialization.

item: Reordered operation logs leave phantom occupied capacity
note: Paused insertion in expire_after_create, removed the published entry, ran maintenance, then resumed. The empty map reported count/weight one; repeated maintenance and invalidate_all preserved it, and a capacity-one cache rejected another key.

item: Failed optimistic replacements corrupt weight accounting
note: Controlled two replacements using a valid blocking Clone. Actual weight 13 was accounted as 12; removing the updated entry left actual weight 10 accounted as nine. Shared metadata changes precede successful map replacement.

With maintenance after every write, 65,534 replacements expired cleanly to count/weight zero. At 65,535 replacements, get rejected the expired entry but repeated maintenance retained count/weight one. Ordinary comparison prevents policy generation wrapping.

item: Returning None fails to clear an elapsed expiration
note: After a 20ms deadline elapsed, get_with returned the replacement but immediate get returned None despite expire_after_update returning None. The elapsed duration and absent expiration both compare as None, skipping deadline clearing.
Expired entries with per-entry deadlines produced Explicit on invalidation and Replaced on replacement. Classification checks global TTL/TTI but omits the per-entry deadline.
Reproduced all four diagnostics using cargo doc with private items and RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings'. These are documentation-link and build-cleanliness issues.

item: Unsafe operations lack local safety comments
note: Clippy independently reported 77 unsafe-block and 13 unsafe-implementation comment warnings. Missing justifications are review/documentation hygiene and do not themselves establish unsoundness.
Independent checks confirmed 23 undocumented public items under src, including 14 debug-counter items, and 20 missing Errors-section warnings. These are documentation hygiene.
The missing_debug_implementations lint independently confirmed eight public types. This is public-API diagnostic-formatting hygiene.
